en.title: 5 Movies You'll Love If You Adored 'Love of Your Life'
en.summary: After falling for the charming 'Love of Your Life,' discover five more films that capture that same heartfelt magic, perfect for your next cozy movie night.
en.body:
## 1. Set It Up
This delightful Netflix rom-com from 2018 offers a fresh take on the classic 'enemies-to-lovers' trope. Two overworked assistants, Harper and Charlie, decide to set up their demanding bosses to get them off their backs, only to find themselves falling for each other in the process. The witty banter and undeniable chemistry between Zoey Deutch and Glen Powell make this a must-watch for anyone who enjoys clever, feel-good romance.

## 2. Always Be My Maybe
Starring and co-written by Ali Wong and Randall Park, this 2019 Netflix gem revisits a childhood romance that reignites years later. Sasha and Marcus, who were high school sweethearts, reconnect after 15 years and grapple with their vastly different lives and lingering feelings. Its blend of humor, genuine emotion, and a surprisingly hilarious Keanu Reeves cameo makes it a standout in the genre.

## 3. Plus One
This 2019 indie darling, directed by Jeff Chan and Andrew Rhymer, explores the complexities of modern dating through the eyes of two long-time platonic friends, Alice and Ben. They agree to be each other's plus-ones for every wedding they attend that summer, navigating awkward encounters and discovering their true feelings. The film's grounded portrayal of friendship evolving into romance, coupled with the charming performances from Maya Erskine and Jack Quaid, resonates deeply.

## 4. When Harry Met Sally...
Considered a benchmark of the romantic comedy genre, this 1989 classic directed by Rob Reiner is essential viewing. It poses the age-old question: can men and women truly be just friends? Billy Crystal and Meg Ryan deliver iconic performances as Harry and Sally, whose relationship evolves over a decade of chance encounters. Its sharp dialogue and realistic depiction of a slow-burn romance have cemented its place in cinematic history.

## 5. The Big Sick
Based on the true story of Kumail Nanjiani and Emily V. Gordon, this critically acclaimed 2017 film offers a poignant and often humorous look at cross-cultural relationships and unexpected love. When Kumail and his girlfriend Emily face a sudden health crisis, their families and cultural differences are put to the test. The film's raw honesty, heartfelt performances, and unique blend of comedy and drama make it a deeply moving experience that captures the essence of finding love in unpredictable circumstances.
Bottom Line: These five films offer a spectrum of heartfelt, witty, and relatable romantic journeys that are sure to enchant fans of 'Love of Your Life.'

content_raw: If you fell head over heels in love with the Amazon Prime Video movie "Love of Your Life," try these five romance movies next.
